newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 27.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 27.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 4.53 points to close at 6,880.70.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index gained 8.25 points to 1,225.59. The all-share EMAS index rose 3.76 to 359.55.
* National car distributor Edaran Otomobil Nasional releases 1996 financial results after 0900 GMT.
* A consortium of Telekom Malaysia and SBC Communications Inc signed a deal to buy a 30 percent stake in South Africa's Telkom for $1.26 billion.
* Malaysia said it was suspending new bilateral dealings with Singapore over unkind remarks made by Singapore Senior Minister Lee Kuan Yew about a Malaysian state.
* Shell Refining posted a 50.6 percent increase in 1996 net profit to 112.04 million ringgit.
* Kumpulan Guthrie reported a 15.4 percent rise in 1996 net earnings to 151.54 million ringgit.
* Highlands & Lowlands announced a 32.7 percent rise in 1996 net profit to 158.94 million ringgit.
* Chase Perdana posted a 33.1 percent increase in 1996 net profit to 11.59 million ringgit.
